articles.title: Fake Disability, Real Theft? UP Man Held in Bengaluru for Allegedly Stealing Mobile Phone
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A man from Uttar Pradesh was allegedly caught by local residents in Bengaluru's ITI Layout near Byatarayanapura for reportedly stealing a mobile phone while pretending to be physically disabled and begging.

body.html:
A man from Uttar Pradesh was allegedly caught by local residents in Bengaluru's ITI Layout near Byatarayanapura for reportedly stealing a mobile phone while pretending to be physically disabled and begging.

The accused, identified as Mukesh, allegedly posed as a man with a disability by limping to gain sympathy from people while seeking alms in the area.

According to residents, they became suspicious of his activities and confronted him. During the confrontation, his alleged deception came to light. Locals claimed that despite having no apparent physical disability, Mukesh was using the act of begging to target mobile phones.

Videos of the incident, which have gone viral on social media, purportedly show the accused standing upright, folding his hands and apologising after being confronted by residents.

The locals later handed him over to the police for further investigation.

Police are verifying the allegations and investigating the matter.

#Bengaluru #Karnataka #MobileTheft #ViralVideo

articles.title: Former Tenant Storms Ex-Landlord's Home With Sword in Nagpur, Woman Killed, Two Seriously Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A long-standing personal dispute allegedly turned deadly on Tuesday morning when a former tenant reportedly entered his ex-landlord's residence armed with a sword and a knife in Amar Nagar under the MIDC police station limits in Nagpur.

body.html:
A long-standing personal dispute allegedly turned deadly on Tuesday morning when a former tenant reportedly entered his ex-landlord's residence armed with a sword and a knife in Amar Nagar under the MIDC police station limits in Nagpur.

The attack claimed the life of 40-year-old Sangeeta Chaudhary, while her sister Vanita Dahat (48) and brother-in-law Dharmapal Dahat (51) sustained serious injuries.

Police identified the accused as 30-year-old Roshan Taral, a resident of Narkhed in Nagpur district.

According to investigators, Taral had rented a room at the Dahat family's house for several months before moving to Rajiv Nagar nearly a year ago. During his stay, disputes allegedly arose over issues such as playing the radio at high volume and being reprimanded for minor mistakes. Police said the accused claimed he felt repeatedly humiliated by the family and remained resentful after being asked to vacate the house. Investigators are also examining whether other personal grievances, including issues involving a former girlfriend, contributed to the attack.

Police said Taral allegedly arrived at the house around 9 am with a sword and knife concealed in a bag. Dharmapal Dahat was sitting in the front room using his mobile phone when he was allegedly attacked. While trying to defend himself, he suffered severe injuries to his hand, with several fingers reportedly severed, before another blow struck his face.

Hearing the commotion, Vanita Dahat rushed from the kitchen to help her husband but was allegedly attacked with a knife, sustaining serious head injuries. Investigators noted that chapatis were still on the tawa, indicating she had been cooking when the assault began.

Sangeeta Chaudhary, who had been staying with her sister for the past few days, came out after hearing the disturbance. Police said she was not the intended target but was allegedly attacked with a sword, suffering a fatal throat injury. Despite her injuries, she reportedly ran outside before collapsing on the road due to excessive bleeding.

Eyewitnesses told police that after the attack, Taral briefly came outside carrying both weapons and allegedly threatened nearby residents before returning inside the house and locking himself in. Local residents locked the main entrance from outside, preventing his escape until MIDC police arrived, forced open the door and arrested him.

The injured couple was shifted to a private hospital in Wanadongri for treatment, while Sangeeta's body was sent for post-mortem examination.

Police have registered a case of murder and attempt to murder. Further investigation is underway.

#Nagpur #Maharashtra #CrimeNews #Murder

articles.title: CCTV Captures Another Crash at Baramati's Accident-Prone Supe Junction Days After Two Brothers Were
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Another serious road accident has been reported at the accident-prone intersection in Supe village of Baramati taluka, just three days after two brothers lost their lives in a fatal crash at the same location.

body.html:
Another serious road accident has been reported at the accident-prone intersection in Supe village of Baramati taluka, just three days after two brothers lost their lives in a fatal crash at the same location.

According to reports, the latest accident occurred on Tuesday when a resident of Varvand in Daund taluka suffered critical injuries. The victim was rushed to a hospital and is currently undergoing treatment.

The entire incident was captured on CCTV cameras installed near the intersection, highlighting the recurring safety concerns at the spot.

The latest crash has renewed demands from local residents for immediate measures to improve road safety. They have urged the authorities to take corrective steps to prevent further accidents at the notorious junction.

articles.title: Instagram Chats Turn Deadly: Rajkot Man Allegedly Beaten to Death Over Messages to Friend's Sister
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 23-year-old man was allegedly beaten to death by his friend and his associates in Gujarat's Rajkot after the accused objected to his Instagram messages to the friend's sister.

body.html:
A 23-year-old man was allegedly beaten to death by his friend and his associates in Gujarat's Rajkot after the accused objected to his Instagram messages to the friend's sister. Police have arrested three accused, while proceedings have also been initiated against a minor allegedly involved in the crime.

The deceased, Umang Jakhelia, was a resident of the Rukhadia Phatak area and worked as a painter. According to the complaint filed by his father, Ranjeet Jakhelia, the main accused, Nazir, and another man arrived at their house on July 27 and took Umang away on a scooter, saying they were going out for tea.

Police said Umang was taken to a deserted area near the old railway station, where Nazir, along with co-accused Sujal Ramavat, allegedly assaulted him with sticks and metal pipes for nearly an hour. At around 5 pm, the accused allegedly abandoned the critically injured man near his locality and fled.

Family members rushed Umang to Rajkot Civil Hospital, where doctors declared him dead. Police said the body bore multiple injury marks consistent with a brutal assault.

During the investigation, police found that Umang had been in contact with Nazir's sister through social media. Investigators believe Nazir became enraged after discovering the Instagram messages and allegedly planned the attack.

Police also said Umang was a close friend of Nazir's elder brother, Ghulam Hussain alias Asif Kakkal, and frequently visited the family's home.

Pradyumnanagar police have registered a case under relevant provisions related to murder and common intention and arrested Nazir alias Gheti, Asif Kakkal and Sujal Ramavat. A minor accused is being produced before the Juvenile Justice Board in accordance with legal procedure.

Further investigation is underway to determine the exact sequence of events and the role of each accused.

#Rajkot #Gujarat #CrimeNews #Murder #Instagram

articles.title: Woman Held for Allegedly Strangling 3-Year-Old Son During Call With Alleged Lover
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 32-year-old woman has been arrested for allegedly strangling her three-year-old son to death in Uttar Pradesh's Mathura district after the child reportedly kept crying while she was on a phone call with her alleged lover.

body.html:
A 32-year-old woman has been arrested for allegedly strangling her three-year-old son to death in Uttar Pradesh's Mathura district after the child reportedly kept crying while she was on a phone call with her alleged lover.

According to police, the incident took place on June 28 in Chhauli village under the Baldev police station limits.

The child's father, Krishna Murari Gupta, who runs a medical store, was at work when his wife, Ruchi Jindal, called him claiming that their son had fallen ill after crying continuously and had become unresponsive. The family rushed the child to several doctors and later to a private hospital in Mathura, where he was declared dead.

Believing the death was linked to polio drops administered earlier that day, the family buried the child's body without suspecting any foul play.

The case came to light on Monday after Krishna Murari allegedly overheard his wife narrating the incident to her alleged lover over the phone. Police said the woman later confessed to the crime before her family and investigators.

The woman's brother-in-law, Govind Gupta, examined her call records and alleged that she had been in frequent contact with a man for long durations.

Police have registered a case based on the complaint lodged by Govind Gupta. The child's body will be exhumed for a post-mortem examination, and further legal action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation.

#Mathura #UttarPradesh #CrimeNews #BreakingNews #ChildDeath

articles.title: Viral ‘Snake Dance’ Driving Video From Malshej Ghat Sparks Road Safety Concerns
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video showing a goods-carrying pickup truck allegedly performing a dangerous “snake dance” while driving through Maharashtra’s Malshej Ghat has gone viral on social media, triggering concern among motorists.

body.html:
A video showing a goods-carrying pickup truck allegedly performing a dangerous “snake dance” while driving through Maharashtra’s Malshej Ghat has gone viral on social media, triggering concern among motorists.

The incident reportedly took place on the Kalyan–Ahilyanagar Highway, where the pickup truck was allegedly seen moving erratically on the winding ghat road. Malshej Ghat is considered an accident-prone stretch due to its sharp turns and challenging terrain.

Motorists have raised concerns over reckless driving by goods vehicle operators, saying such dangerous manoeuvres can put the lives of other road users at serious risk.

According to reports, some drivers who witnessed the incident intercepted the pickup truck and confronted the driver. The driver was allegedly assaulted by some motorists following the incident.

Authorities have urged vehicle operators to avoid dangerous stunts and strictly follow traffic rules, especially on accident-prone routes. Further action against the pickup truck driver, if found guilty, is awaited.

#MalshejGhat #Maharashtra #RoadSafety #DangerousDriving

articles.title: Passenger Allegedly Grabs Steering Wheel of Moving ST Bus in Latur, Crash
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major road accident was reported in Maharashtra's Latur after a passenger allegedly pulled the steering wheel of a moving State Transport (ST) bus, causing it to crash into three school buses parked along the roadside.

body.html:
A major road accident was reported in Maharashtra's Latur after a passenger allegedly pulled the steering wheel of a moving State Transport (ST) bus, causing it to crash into three school buses parked along the roadside. The incident occurred at around 2.30 pm on Monday on the Latur–Ausa road.

According to reports, the passenger suddenly entered the driver's cabin and forcefully grabbed the steering wheel, allegedly saying, "I want to ***." The bus went out of control, overturned on one side of the road and collided with three parked school buses.

Videos from the scene have surfaced on social media showing the injured driver, with blood visible on his face, confronting the accused by holding him by the collar. The passenger was also assaulted by another commuter, while others criticised him for allegedly endangering the lives of everyone on board.

Latur depot manager Rathod said no fatalities were reported in the incident. However, around five passengers sustained minor injuries and were taken to a government hospital for treatment.

The bus driver, identified as Mahadev Devrao Devgunde (50), suffered serious injuries to his hand and face and is undergoing treatment at a private hospital in Latur.

Following the incident, police detained the accused passenger after the bus driver lodged a complaint. Further investigation is underway.

#Latur #Maharashtra #BusAccident #RoadAccident

articles.title: Marriage Dispute Turns Violent in Bihar: Woman Dragged by Boyfriend's Bike in Rajgir
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident has come to light from Rajgir in Bihar's Nalanda district, where a young woman was allegedly dragged for nearly 100 metres by her boyfriend after a dispute over marriage. A video of the incident has surfaced on social media.

body.html:
A shocking incident has come to light from Rajgir in Bihar's Nalanda district, where a young woman was allegedly dragged for nearly 100 metres by her boyfriend after a dispute over marriage. A video of the incident has surfaced on social media.

According to police, the accused, who works as an Amin in Nardiganj, Nawada district, had come to Rajgir to meet the woman around four to five days ago. During their meeting, the woman reportedly raised the issue of marriage, but the accused allegedly refused, leading to a heated argument.

Police said the man then attempted to leave on his motorcycle. When the woman tried to stop him by holding onto the bike, he allegedly continued riding, dragging her for about 100 metres despite her pleas to stop.

The accused eventually lost control of the motorcycle and both fell onto the road. In the viral video, bystanders are seen running behind the bike while recording the incident. After the fall, locals rushed to help the woman, and one person is seen assaulting the accused before others intervened and calmed the situation.

When questioned by people at the scene, the accused allegedly claimed that the woman was his wife and described it as a domestic matter.

Rajgir police said the incident stemmed from a marriage dispute between the couple, who had reportedly been in a long-term relationship. The woman is a resident of the Rajgir police station area, while the accused is from Nawada district.

Police said the victim has filed a written complaint against the accused at Nardiganj police station in Nawada district. Further investigation is underway.

#Bihar #Nalanda #Rajgir #ViralVideo #MarriageDispute

articles.title: Viral Video Triggers Probe After Student Beaten Inside Bihar Government School
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The Bihar Education Department has launched an investigation after a video allegedly showing a student being beaten inside a government school in Gopalganj district, the home district of the state's Education Minister, went viral on social media.

body.html:
The Bihar Education Department has launched an investigation after a video allegedly showing a student being beaten inside a government school in Gopalganj district, the home district of the state's Education Minister, went viral on social media.

The incident reportedly took place at the Upgraded Middle School in Pyarepur under Thawe block. While the authenticity of the viral video has not been independently verified, it appears to show a man entering a classroom and repeatedly beating a student with a stick as other children watch in fear.

In the video, a student is heard saying that the police should be called to stop the assault. A teacher also tries to intervene, urging the man not to beat the child, but the assault allegedly continues.

According to reports, the incident occurred around 3 pm on Monday when students were playing on the school campus. Chandrashekhar Nath Choubey, a resident of Pyarepur village, allegedly entered the school and assaulted the student with a stick.

Following the incident, the school administration informed senior officials. On Tuesday, In-charge Block Education Officer (BEO) Samrat Shivmani visited the school and recorded statements from teachers, villagers and other concerned persons.

The school administration alleged that the accused had previously created disturbances and engaged in violent incidents on the campus. Villagers said Chandrashekhar Nath Choubey is also the donor of the land on which the school stands. He has also been accused of locking two rooms containing school records and the headmaster's office, allegedly disrupting school operations.

District Education Officer (DEO) Amarendra Kumar Pandey has directed the BEO to submit a detailed investigation report and instructed the school headmaster to lodge an FIR against the accused.

The DEO said outsiders cannot be allowed to enter school premises and assault students, adding that strict action would be taken against anyone taking the law into their own hands. The BEO confirmed that the process of registering an FIR against Chandrashekhar Nath Choubey at Thawe police station has been initiated. Further action will be taken based on the investigation report.

#Bihar #Gopalganj #School #ViralVideo #Education

articles.title: Viral Machete Videos Land Bengaluru Rowdy-Sheeter Behind Bars, CCB Arrests Absconding Accused
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The Bengaluru Central Crime Branch (CCB) has arrested an alleged rowdy-sheeter who had been evading the police while allegedly roaming through J.J. Nagar brandishing a long machete and posting videos of the act on social media.

body.html:
The Bengaluru Central Crime Branch (CCB) has arrested an alleged rowdy-sheeter who had been evading the police while allegedly roaming through J.J. Nagar brandishing a long machete and posting videos of the act on social media.

The accused has been identified as Toushif Khan, a resident of J.J. Nagar.

According to a senior police officer, Toushif Khan is accused in multiple criminal cases, including assault and attempt to murder. He had allegedly failed to appear before the court in connection with the cases and had been absconding, making it difficult for police to trace him.

Investigators said that despite being on the run, the accused frequently entered J.J. Nagar carrying a long machete in public and uploaded videos of himself dancing with the weapon on social media, allegedly to project his influence and intimidate local residents.

After tracking his movements, the CCB arrested Toushif Khan and produced him before a court, which remanded him to judicial custody.

Further investigation is underway.

#Bengaluru #CCB #JJNagar #RowdySheeter #CrimeNews
